Distinguish what the Council requested from the positions recorded in the delivered statements.", "sources": [{"id": "vote", "text": "On 29 December 2023 the Council adopted Japan and the United Arab Emirates’ draft S/2023/1056 as resolution 2721, by 13 votes in favour, none against and two abstentions, China and Russia."}, {"id": "assessment", "text": "The resolution encouraged consideration of the independent assessment and its recommendations for coordinated international engagement. It also recognized the need for full, equal, meaningful and safe participation by Afghan women."}, {"id": "ru-condition", "text": "Russia expected consultation with the de facto authorities and consideration of all Council members’ views. It said it would withhold support for the envoy appointment without agreement from the de facto authorities."}, {"id": "consultation", "text": "Paragraph 3 asks the Secretary-General to appoint an envoy after consulting Council members, relevant Afghan actors including authorities, women and civil society, the region and the wider international community. Its appointment terms contain no consent requirement."}]}
